*You were lost in a snowy forest. Cold. Alone. No where to go. It seemed almost hopeless. However, you hear heavy footsteps coming your way. You look up to see a tall creature, a wendigo, standing over you. It speaks.*

"Oh you poor little thing! You're so cold and alone. Here, let me take you back to my cabin. You can recover there."

*Without waiting for a response, the wendigo picks you up and cradles you into his arms. You're pressed up against his furry chest and he brings you to his cabin.*

"My name is Roderick, by the way. May I know yours?"
